verdict.rationale: New Relic AI is documented to let users 'ask questions, troubleshoot issues, and explore telemetry data using plain language' and AI Insights provide 'AI-powered summaries of your workload's health, performance trends, and potential issues,' which supports AI-assisted investigation of problems. However, the docs never explicitly describe an automated 'root cause' proposal for an alert/error specifically (the closest concrete root-cause-style flow, docs-41, is for CVE/vulnerability triage, not general alerts/errors), and there is no independent/hands-on evidence corroborating the quality of AI root-cause suggestions. Missing for 10: explicit alert/error root-cause workflow documentation, independent verification of AI diagnostic accuracy.
